meta.topic: Being the Same When No One's Looking

headline: Integrity is consistency between your values and your actions—being the same person in private as in public
universal_truth: Who you are when no one is watching is who you actually are
fun_facts: The word 'integrity' comes from the Latin 'integer' meaning 'whole' or 'complete'
Studies show people are significantly more likely to cheat when they believe they won't be caught
Integrity reduces decision fatigue—you don't have to calculate what you can get away with
discussion_questions: When are you most tempted to act differently than your values?
How do you maintain integrity when no one would know if you didn't?
What does your private behavior reveal about your true values?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Would you return a wallet you found on an empty street? Would you work as hard without a boss watching? Integrity is being the same person when no one's watching as when everyone is. It's wholeness—no gap between values and actions.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Integrity is easy when others are watching. It's tested when you could get away with cutting corners. What actually keeps people aligned when no one would know?

options.text: People with integrity see themselves as the watcher—they care about being consistent with their self-image, not just avoiding punishment
options.response: Yes. Integrity is about who you are, not what you can get away with. The person with integrity acts the same because they're watching themselves.

options.text: Fear of eventually being discovered keeps people honest
options.response: Fear of discovery motivates some, but true integrity doesn't depend on getting caught...

q1.title: The Gap Problem
q1.script: Most people have gaps between stated values and actual behavior. We say we value honesty but tell white lies. We say we value health but skip exercise. Integrity means closing these gaps—or honestly acknowledging them.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "The Gap Problem"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Decision Simplification
q2.script: Integrity reduces mental load. When you're integrated, you don't calculate what you can get away with—you just act according to your values. It's simpler to be consistent than to manage multiple versions of yourself.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Private as Practice
q3.script: Your private behavior is practice for your public behavior. What you do when no one's watching shapes who you become. Every private choice either strengthens or weakens your integrity muscles.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Who you are when no one is watching is who you actually are. Integrity means there's no difference—you're whole, the same person in every context.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 194. Tomorrow, we'll explore owning what you do—responsibility. Until then, notice a private choice you make and ask: would I be comfortable if everyone could see this?
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Private Audit - Who Are You Alone?
growTrack.learning_objective: Examine private behavior for integrity gaps
growTrack.activity: Think about how you behave when alone or unobserved. Is it consistent with your stated values? Where are the gaps? Closing them doesn't mean performing for an invisible audience—it means becoming the same person throughout.
